meta.title: Las Fuertes - Something Powerful is Coming
meta.description: We are building a space for Comprehensive Menstrual Education (CME) to mark a new milestone in Colombia.

hero.subtitle1: Even though you can't see it yet, what's coming

section2.paragraph: Silence, ignorance, and disinformation have for years created **habits, walls and barriers that float in violent and discriminatory realities for girls as they grow.**

section3.title: A topic so natural, historically ignored, ==why talk about it now?==
section3.text: The dignity and rights of girls and adolescents are like seawater, they never expire, and in **Las Fuertes** we embark on this irreversible mission with a unique educational map, breaking down walls and barriers.

welcome.subtitle: from Isla Fuerte, Colombia
welcome.body: A space where **comprehensive menstrual education** becomes a tool for transformation; here we accompany girls and adolescents to know, understand, and **live their cycle with freedom and confidence.**

emi.title: Comprehensive menstrual education as a map for change
emi.paragraph1: From that attentive listening and the desire to move new tides, **EMI** is born, our **Comprehensive Menstrual Education** program.
emi.paragraph2: A living proposal, woven from experience in Isla Fuerte and other territories in Colombia; here we understood that menstrual education is not enough on its own: **we need a broad vision** of integrity that allows every girl to inhabit her body with freedom and pride.

donations.title: Leading change with comprehensive menstrual education requires committed crews
donations.paragraph1: **Turn your money into collective action.** More valuable than any investment because it takes us to new destinations while deepening our impact.
donations.paragraph2: Every contribution creates a wave... and your constant support shapes currents of change and new opportunities.

educationMap.title: How our educational map becomes the route toward conscious integral development

talleres.name: Workshops (EMI)
talleres.body: It is always about them. We create safe spaces where, through workshops and a method of our own, menstrual education becomes a bridge to new opportunities.
talleres.imageAlt: Three girls point at a poster about internal reproductive anatomy during a workshop.

clubes.name:
Reading and
fun clubs
clubes.body: We create more spaces for self-knowledge so they can grow up safe and free. Through recreational and educational activities, we help girls and teenagers build their confidence.
clubes.imageAlt: A group of girls works around outdoor tables at a reading club.

ruta.name:
My route, my
destination
ruta.body: Las Fuertes Junior keep discovering their talents, skills and areas for growth, strengthening their self-esteem and the way they see themselves. With that self-knowledge as a foundation, we support them in making conscious decisions about their short, medium and long term future.
ruta.imageAlt: A group of girls and teenagers holds up their new backpacks and smiles.

chiquifuertes.name: Chiquifuertes
chiquifuertes.body: Girls discovering their first territory: their body. Through play and drawing we spark their imagination, teamwork and self-knowledge, planting the skills to grow up strong, creative and free.
chiquifuertes.imageAlt: Two girls draw and colour while sitting on a mat.

voces.name:
Sovereign Voices:
Youth Leadership
voces.body: Going beyond puberty is essential to nurture the value of community work as a tool for individual and collective transformation. At Las Fuertes we stop being a single voice and weave a network of dozens.
voces.imageAlt: Two teenagers and a Las Fuertes facilitator sit together for a portrait.

hero.title: Join Las Fuertes
hero.subtitle: Every girl on Isla Fuerte deserves tools to build her future. You can be part of that today, from wherever you are.

especie.title: Your things can change a story
especie.text: On the island there are no tech shops or big stationery stores. What is no longer useful to you opens doors here. We receive:
especie.item3: School supplies, notebooks and art materials
especie.item4: Children's and young adult books in Spanish

llegue.title: The Llegue-Llegue: shopping with purpose
llegue.text: At our headquarters on Isla Fuerte we run the Llegue-Llegue, our mini second-hand clothing store of good quality. Every garment sold directly supports the foundation's programs.

llegue.donateNote: To shop you have to visit us on the island, but from anywhere you can donate clothes in good condition and give the store more stock.

voluntariado.text: You don't need to be on the island or be a teacher to help. If you have a skill, you have something to give. We're looking for remote support in:

quienesSomos.title: Who are we?
quienesSomos.text: We are a reef of women, volunteers and allies growing from Bogotá toward Colombia's forgotten territories. We build spaces where knowledge of the body is not whispered but shared, where comprehensive menstrual education is not a luxury but a right. And where every adolescent finds her own voice to navigate her life with clarity, confidence and freedom.
